details: A 156MB darwin-arm64 binary is published under the official @cognition-ai/cli-darwin-arm64 package name (version 3000.6.11, beta tag) but declares no bin mapping and no lifecycle scripts, so installing it provides no functional CLI. The package ships a single compiled Rust binary at bin/devin that embeds Devin CLI internals (cargo registry paths, sandbox-runtime, plugin-host, windsurf-api-client components). The package takes over the official Cognition AI Devin CLI package name with a non-functional binary-only payload, consistent with a supply-chain impersonation of the Devin CLI.
